display_long_description:
Enter the battlefield in Call of Courage: World War 2, an immersive VR WW2 shooting game and action packed military FPS built for true virtual reality combat. Experience intense frontline war missions, realistic weapon handling, and story driven survival gameplay in one of the most engaging World War 2 VR shooter games available offline.
Fight as a frontline soldier, become an elite sniper, or command powerful war tanks in a complete WW2 FPS experience designed for VR action lovers and military game fans.

🎮 Multiple Gameplay Modes for Ultimate War Experience

Soldier Mode: Frontline Infantry Combat
Sniper Mode: Tactical Precision Shooting
Tank Mode: Heavy War Machine Warfare

🎮 Key Features

   Frontline Infantry Combat
   Tactical Sniper Operations
   Explosive Tank Warfare
   Loyal War Dog Companion
   True VR Weapon Handling
   Cinematic War Experience
   Dynamic War Environments
   Survival-Focused Missions
   Intense Battlefield Action
   Realistic Combat 


Play anytime without internet connection and experience full VR immersion with action packed missions, emotional storytelling, and dynamic battlefield encounters.
If you enjoy WW2 games, VR shooter games, military FPS action, sniper games, tank warfare, or immersive war simulators, Call of Courage: World War 2 delivers one of the most intense virtual reality war experiences available.
Become the soldier. Take the sniper shot. Command the tank.
Fight for victory in the ultimate World War 2 VR battlefield.
